fixed_item_pair_per_observation_window.injection: At observation entry, two sequential validated vanilla writes; no atomic pair claim or refeeding.

conditions.observer: one serial RCON issuer; no sidecar RCON

notes: 20 endpoints / 6 channels is this given-load cohort, not1000-endpoint or peak-capacity evidence.
The workload uses only two stable ITEM payload variants, each32 items per batch. Payload cardinality is2; repeated batches do not increase component-type coverage.
Assets are validated input/output ledgers. SQL/WAL/local credit mirrors and transfer record amounts are never added as assets.
Fixed SQL/WAL counters end before final drain. Lifecycle costs include recorded tail drain/quiet, not indefinite future maintenance.
Success-to-success output gaps are observer intervals, not proof of continuously pending demand. Controlled FE hold overlaps are separate; cold channels deliberately have gaps between inputs.
Process points labeled0/30/60min are actual scheduled samples with their read spans. Sampled RSS/heap/queue maxima are not continuous peaks or a memory-leak proof.
GC deltas are cumulative jstat counter/time differences, not pause p95/p99 or CPU time. FGC0 does not establish no leakage.
Full probe histograms measure selected mod main-thread root wall spans per complete logical tick and whole tickServer calls; no claim of all mod CPU or uninstrumented GUI/compat code.
All business bounds use the single Python monotonic observer. No raw nanoTime subtraction across JVMs and no world-save/durability latency claim.
History is post-stop retained-created reconstruction, not continuous row/physical-size monitoring. Removed records cannot be recovered from final created_at rows.
Allocation rate and exact per-reason asset-bearing work ratio are UNMEASURED. reason_effective includes checkpoint work.

fixed_counter_delta.scope: Actual per-server cumulative status and root-observed ct_dev SQL attempts; missing counters UNMEASURED. End rings/avg100 are snapshots, not window percentiles. Credit publications include cross delivery. Native local_input/output_units may mix resource units and are diagnostics, not external throughput/asset totals.

lifecycle_counter_delta.scope: Actual per-server cumulative status and root-observed ct_dev SQL attempts; missing counters UNMEASURED. End rings/avg100 are snapshots, not window percentiles. Credit publications include cross delivery. Native local_input/output_units may mix resource units and are diagnostics, not external throughput/asset totals.

service_observations.scope: Only observation:business records counted, excluding duplicate RCON traces and separate tail. Gaps are observations, never inferred pending-demand starvation.

B.scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. A fixed live snapshot has one fewer completed cycle than completed tick frames; the current incomplete cycle is excluded. Stop seals at the next tick start, flushes the final complete cycle, and excludes that new tick frame; sealed cycles must equal tick frames. No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.
B.coverage_limits: Explicit whitelist only. Includes actual TesseractBlockEntity.saveAdditional and selected compat.changed/AE insert-extract-inventory/GT energy mutation/Mek chemical-heat mutation entries. Uninstrumented GUI, other save/load hooks, other compat callbacks/getters, method prefixes/suffixes, and outside-tick work are excluded from the per-tick sum. Optional compat hooks with no actual calls remain unexercised; transformed_classes records actual loaded descriptors.

scope: Post-stop read-only endpoint/channel/server-scoped terminal rows, not live instrumentation.
created_at UTC buckets reconstruct surviving rows at audit time; removed history, update volume, peak live rows and continuous physical database/index size are UNMEASURED.
Creation buckets are sparse UTC epoch30s/60s intervals; absent intervals have zero retained rows, not proof of zero historical inserts before retention.
Transfer state is state at audit time, not the state at creation. Counts are records, never additional assets.
ct_resources reports distinct referenced rows; exclusive row creation is UNMEASURED because resources can be shared across fixtures.
Subject-scoped operation/audit rows are attributable IDs only; other subject types remain UNMEASURED. Target-server outbox/inbox rows describe this cohort's server delivery scope.
Shared ct_clusters/ct_player_guards and physical SQL/table/WAL byte growth are UNMEASURED. History used is a quota counter, separate from actual row counts.
